profile.headline: Software Engineer Sr.
profile.summary: Experienced IT professional with a history in all different areas of information technology, with proven experience in putting expertise to practice. Master of computer science and operation from over a decade of working with and on computers. Developed communication, cooperation, and leadership skills from IT support career to interact both with clients and company. Knowledge of setting up a network or other system and experienced in performing maintenance on a regular basis. Extensive familiarity with raw and processed numbers and analytical experience. A candidate ready to utilize more than 10 years of experience in IT to excel in any position.
